_comment: documentLinkProvider.resolveProvider: the server returns links with a range and NO target, deferring it to documentLink/resolve (vscode-json-language-server does this for every $ref). Those links used to be dropped in the parse, so they were silently un-clickable. The second link has an inline target and must not be resolved. A link that is never resolved must still not reach the host as a dead underline.
